design: Version 2 index ports (stores.EligibilityIndexPort): upsert(..., attributes=index_attributes(item)) stores the version's eligibility attributes beside the pointer payload (PostgreSQL jsonb column, Qdrant 'eligibility' payload key); get/read_back/entries keep returning the pointer only, so binding, read-back and reconciliation are unchanged. search_eligible evaluates an EligibilityPredicate inside the backend query (WHERE / payload filter); score_entries returns the backend's own score for exactly the given entries; retire marks every entry of an item older than a version as superseded.

EligibilityPredicate: requested kinds and scopes, superseded=false, ACTIVE, not deleted, valid_from <= valid_at < valid_until, expires_at > now (boundary clock), optional source kinds, content schemas, min confidence and excluded taint labels; instants as integer microseconds with an exact 'unbounded' sentinel below 2**53. accepts() is the reference semantics; the real adapters are tested branch by branch against it.

Metadata port version 2 (stores.EligibilityMetadataStore.eligible_versions): committed head versions of a partition whose stored item matches the predicate, evaluated in the PostgreSQL WHERE joined to the head pointers.

MemoryStoreCoordinator: after the visibility switch of version n it retires version n-1's projections in every layout of n-1 and n (also across partitions after a reclassification); a replayed commit and reconciliation repeat it; a lost retirement fails the commit closed with PREDECESSOR_NOT_RETIRED (version committed, predecessor still dropped post-query). lexical_candidates/vector_candidates keep their signature (EmbeddingLifecycleCoordinator overrides vector_candidates) and read the predicate from eligibility_scope (a context variable set by MemorySearchService around candidate lookup); inside a scope an index that is not version 2 fails closed (INDEX_PREDICATES_UNSUPPORTED); outside a scope the version 1 lookup is unchanged. lexical_scores/vector_scores score committed, registered pointers of the partition and fail closed on a missing or invalid score (PROJECTION_DRIFT).

MemorySearchService: the plan carries the predicate (query kinds/scopes/filters, valid_at, boundary now); candidate lookups run inside eligibility_scope; the complete per-candidate re-validation (_eligible) is unchanged. STRUCTURED reads eligible_versions (fail closed METADATA_PREDICATES_UNSUPPORTED otherwise), ranks the eligible set and re-validates lazily in rank order, skipping an ineligible version before it is chosen, so the result equals the ranking of the eligible set (top-k, deterministic, no implicit size cap). HYBRID completes the union of the two pools with the real missing factor from the other backend; lexical scores are normalised over the union after completion. The stop epoch is required before the loop, after each materialised hit and before the receipt. Every MemoryAdmissionError after planning is recorded as searchMemory.denied before it propagates.

normative_interpretations: LLD v1.1 §2.8.4 'revocation, expiry, reclassification or deletion invalidate the representation before the next materialisation' and the PO decision F1(b) are implemented as 'superseded' marking of the predecessor's index entries plus the ACTIVE/validity/expiry predicates, not as deletion: the exact superseded version stays materialisable by read_version (history, exact replay of earlier receipts as 0052 already tested), but never reaches a search result, rank, count or explanation.

F1(d) 'backpressure only for limits declared in configuration and coherent with admission': RetrievalLimits.max_candidates (declared) bounds only the candidates dropped after the query (live policy, races); attribute-ineligible versions never count. STRUCTURED has no implicit size cap. Admission declares no per-partition quota, so no further bound is introduced.

F3: a HYBRID candidate without an index entry of the pinned representation of the other mode has no real factor; it is dropped from the hybrid ranking (fail closed, most restrictive reading) instead of being ranked with a fabricated value, so no new ranking profile version is needed. FULL_TEXT and VECTOR modes keep recording the factor of the other mode as 0.0 because it is not part of their contract (unchanged 0052 behaviour, outside the decision's F3 scope).

F5: the denial event of a post-planning refusal has the shape of the 0052 pre-query denial (action searchMemory.denied, operation/causation/correlation, GCS digest, binding, query digest, reason and detail code, evaluation time, audit_ref); if the audit store is unavailable the refusal is replaced by CONTROL_PLANE_UNAVAILABLE/AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE (fail closed).

out_of_scope_tracked.F2: F2 (out of scope, tracked toward FGM-16): policy-denied items inside an authorized partition still influence the error and the work done (index lookups, timing bucket) because a per-item live policy decision cannot be pushed into the index query. The F1 correction does not make it worse: test_f2_policy_denied_items_cost_no_more_index_work_than_before measures 1, 6 and 15 index lookups for 0, 40 and 130 denied items (the review's baseline) and 130 still fails with RETRIEVAL_BACKPRESSURE.

a commit retires the predecessor's projections (superseded=true in the PostgreSQL attributes and the Qdrant eligibility payload, also across partitions after a reclassification) while the exact superseded version stays materialisable; a REVOKED head is never searchable in any mode; an item corrected 130 times plus another item returns the two current heads (R3; RED on 2c110c1 with RETRIEVAL_BACKPRESSURE); a retirement lost after the visibility switch fails the commit closed (PREDECESSOR_NOT_RETIRED), the stale predecessor is still dropped post-query and a replayed commit repairs it; a version rolled forward by reconciliation retires its predecessor too
STRUCTURED with top_k=10 over 130 eligible items returns the 10 hits of the independent ranking oracle, identical on repeat and across fresh adapters (R6; RED on 2c110c1 with RETRIEVAL_BACKPRESSURE)

40 QUARANTINED items cost nothing against max_candidates=2; only post-query drops (live policy denials) consume the declared bound and exceed it with an audited RETRIEVAL_BACKPRESSURE; F2 (out of scope, FGM-16): 0, 40 and 130 policy-denied items cost exactly the review's baseline of 1, 6 and 15 index lookups (JUnit properties f2_index_lookups), 130 still fails with backpressure: not worse

with 21 eligible items, every recorded lexical factor equals the PostgreSQL ts_rank_cd normalised over the union and every vector factor the cosine of the pinned representation, and the ranking equals the oracle ranking on the real factors of the union, for top_k 20 and 10 (R4; RED on 2c110c1: note-13 vector 0.0 / wrong top-10); a candidate found by one index is scored by the other on its own committed entry (score_entries), and scoring refuses a pending, foreign-partition or other-representation pointer (POINTER_UNBOUND) and an entry without a score (PROJECTION_DRIFT); a candidate without the pinned representation is dropped, never given a fabricated factor

a stop raised during the read of the first of 3 hits ends the search after that read with STOP_EPOCH_MISMATCH, no hit, no success receipt and one audited denial (R5; RED on 2c110c1: 3 hits and a success receipt); a stop after the last hit or in a zero-hit search is caught right before the receipt; an unchanged epoch is read exactly 4 times for one hit

POLICY_UNAVAILABLE at materialisation, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED after ranking, STOP_EPOCH_MISMATCH, CANDIDATE_CHANGED and RETRIEVAL_BACKPRESSURE (with the cases of F1/F4 and the updated 0052 tests) each write exactly one searchMemory.denied event with reason, detail, correlation and causation and no success receipt; an unavailable audit store fails closed; a successful search writes only its receipt

ENVELOPE_INVALID, GCS_INVALID, POLICY_DECISION_INVALID before and after the query, STOP_STATE_INVALID (-1, bool, str, float), MATERIALIZED_DIGEST_MISMATCH, STALE_POLICY at materialisation and DEADLINE_EXCEEDED after ranking each refused with the exact reason/detail code, and each followed by the accepted positive case; include_explanation=false yields a hit without explanation_ref; a historical valid_at returns the version valid then in every mode

residual_risks: F2 is out of scope and tracked toward FGM-16 (see out_of_scope_tracked): policy-denied items inside an authorized partition still cost index lookups and can still exhaust the declared bound; measured unchanged (1, 6, 15 lookups; 130 fails).

The 0053 parallel representation (EmbeddingLifecycleCoordinator, sealed embeddings.py) searches its own representation index outside these version 2 ports: its out-of-window and ineligible entries are still skipped by bounded scanning (its own residual, toward FGM-16), and in HYBRID a lexical-only candidate cannot be scored on a parallel representation (no metadata pointer of that version) and is dropped. The 0053 suite passes unchanged.

Index entries written by version 1 adapters (no attributes) are invisible to search_eligible (fail closed, no false positive): existing layouts need a rebuild of the projection after an adapter upgrade; the PoC test worlds are created fresh.

A crash between the visibility switch and the retirement leaves the predecessor's entries unretired until a replayed commit or reconciliation; meanwhile they are dropped post-query (head check) and only cost candidate slots.
The PostgreSQL and Qdrant adapters remain the 0051 test adapters (tests/tasks/test_ocor_dev_0051.py); no production adapter under memory/adapters/ exists yet.

Test-level anonymous Docker volume leaks of pre-existing suites remain allocated to OCOR-DEV-REM-0018 (full-suite resource attribution); the memory suites leave no container, volume or network (task-teardown-delta).
